MR::protocol
       Returns generic, sip or diameter.

SYNOPSIS
       MR::protocol

DESCRIPTION
       returns generic, sip or diameter

RETURN VALUE
       returns generic, sip or diameter

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
	when MR_INGRESS {
	    log local0. "[MR::protocol] router instance [MR::instance]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.5.0 --First introduced the command.
